events.description: A group of individuals, many wearing yellow vests, engage in mutual physical combat around a black sports car; multiple people are seen punching, grappling, and pushing each other in a sustained melee.

A large crowd, predominantly in yellow vests, surrounds vehicles and engages in coordinated aggressive behavior including surrounding, rocking, and damaging a black Porsche; the scene shows collective violent unrest with property destruction and group confrontation.

The black Porsche (license plate EB-040-TM) sustains visible damage to its rear windshield and roof area, consistent with being struck or forcibly rocked by the surrounding crowd; no collision with another vehicle is observed, but the damage occurs during the incident.

A group of people, including individuals wearing yellow vests, surround and actively damage a black Porsche Cayman parked on the street. The car's windshield is shattered, and debris is scattered. Multiple individuals are seen striking or pulling at the vehicle over several seconds, consistent with collective violent unrest.

At least two individuals are seen repeatedly striking and pulling at the damaged car while it is stationary and unoccupied; the car is a helpless object being subjected to sustained destructive attack by multiple persons.

A black Porsche Boxster is engulfed in flames and emitting thick black smoke on a city street, indicating it has been severely damaged—likely by fire following a collision or deliberate act. Police officers on motorcycles observe from a safe distance. The vehicle remains burning throughout the sequence until a fire truck arrives.

The burning car appears to be part of a broader unrest event: multiple police officers in riot gear are present, observing the fire without immediate intervention; background context (urban setting, presence of barriers, and Ruptly watermark suggesting protest coverage) supports classification as riot-related property destruction. No active combat is visible, but the scene aligns with post-incident riot dynamics.
A black Porsche sports car is severely damaged and on fire, with firefighters actively extinguishing the blaze using a hose; the vehicle shows structural damage consistent with a post-crash fire.

A group of riot police in full protective gear, including helmets, shields, and batons, advance aggressively toward a storefront ('La Nouvelle Librairie') while deploying tear gas or smoke canisters, creating dense white smoke on the street. Civilians (including one in a red shirt and another in a yellow vest) are visible near or inside the doorway, appearing to retreat or be displaced. The police movement is coordinated and forceful, with some officers drawing batons and advancing in formation across the street, indicating collective violent unrest or confrontation.

Police in full riot gear advance and deploy tear gas or smoke canisters against a crowd of protesters, including individuals wearing yellow vests, on a city street; the scene shows coordinated police action, dispersal tactics, and visible smoke clouds engulfing the area.
